mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_meta ( id, owner_id, storage_key, size_bytes, content_type, checksum, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{ownerId}, #{storageKey}, #{sizeBytes}, #{contentType}, #{checksum}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET owner_id = EXCLUDED.owner_id, storage_key = EXCLUDED.storage_key, size_bytes = EXCLUDED.size_bytes, content_type = EXCLUDED.content_type, checksum = EXCLUDED.checksum, status = EXCLUDED.status, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at

MERGE INTO file_meta ( id, owner_id, storage_key, size_bytes, content_type, checksum, status, created_at, updated_at ) KEY (id) VALUES ( #{id}, #{ownerId}, #{storageKey}, #{sizeBytes}, #{contentType}, #{checksum}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
